title: Hostinger Node.js build history and completed-build log evidence

phases.objective: Collect bounded authenticated GET-only Hostinger build history and redacted logs for the selected completed or failed post-merge build, extracting source provenance and activation signals without creating builds, deploying, restarting, or exposing credentials.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted release operator and GitHub Actions
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Node.js Build Evidence workflow contract test or trusted workflow dispatch from main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A structured JSON and Markdown artifact identifies the newest post-merge build, reads its logs when completed or failed, redacts secrets, extracts source-context Git revisions and bounded activation/error signals, and classifies expected, conflicting, other, or unverified source provenance.
steps: Validate the Hostinger account username, fixed auth.mad4b.com domain, exact protected Production SHA, and Production merge timestamp.
Perform an authenticated GET for page one of Node.js builds and select the newest build created or updated after the protected merge.
For a completed or failed selected build, perform one authenticated GET for logs from line zero.
Bound and redact the log response before persistence.
Extract full Git SHA values only from source-context lines and retain short revision candidates for expected-prefix matching.
Extract at most thirty bounded activation and error signal lines.
Classify expected revision from logs, another full SHA, metadata/log conflict, source unverified, build failed, or pending outcomes.
Upload the structured artifact before enforcing the evidence decision.
assertions: The API base URL is exactly https://developers.hostinger.com and the live domain is restricted to auth.mad4b.com.
Only GET requests are performed against build-list and selected-build-log endpoints.
The Authorization bearer token is never returned by the report, Markdown, console result, failure messages, or bounded signals.
Provider responses and logs are bounded before persistence.
A completed build may pass when source-context logs expose the exact expected SHA or an expected SHA prefix of at least seven characters.
A different full source SHA fails, while completed builds with no source evidence remain partial.
Metadata and log provenance conflicts fail closed.
No build, deploy, restart, provider mutation, repository mutation, SQL execution, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Use the configured least-privilege Hostinger token to inspect the completed build created immediately after Production f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted release operator and GitHub Actions
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Trusted-main Hostinger Node.js Build Evidence workflow_dispatch after governed single-use authorization
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A secret-free artifact reads the exact completed Hostinger build and its bounded redacted logs through GET-only endpoints, then classifies whether source provenance matches Production f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896 and whether activation signals explain the stale active runtime.
steps: Bind the run to the exact protected Production SHA, Production merge timestamp, auth.mad4b.com domain, Hostinger account, trusted workflow blob, and completed build UUID.
Require trusted-main workflow_dispatch and reject a moved main head, moved Production head, changed workflow blob, changed authorization, or changed build UUID.
Read page one of Hostinger Node.js builds with the configured least-privilege bearer token using GET only.
Select and verify the exact completed build UUID 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658.
Read that build's logs from line zero using GET only.
Bound and redact all provider data before writing JSON, Markdown, console output, or failure details.
Extract only source-context Git revisions plus bounded activation and error signals.
Upload the evidence artifact before enforcing expected, conflicting, other, or unverified provenance outcomes.
assertions: The live evidence workflow can run only from refs/heads/main through workflow_dispatch.
The Hostinger token is supplied only through the configured GitHub secret and is never returned, persisted, echoed, or included in artifacts.
The account, domain, Production SHA, merge timestamp, workflow blob, and completed build UUID are exact immutable inputs.
Provider access is limited to GET build-list and selected-build-log endpoints.
The selected build UUID must equal 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658.
The expected Production SHA must equal f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
The workflow performs no build creation, deployment, restart, active-slot promotion, provider mutation, repository mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send.
The artifact and report declare secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Add bounded pagination and provider correlation-ID preservation without increasing provider write authority.
This evidence path performs no Hostinger mutation or provider canary.
Require authenticated build and selected-build-log evidence alongside public runtime parity after protected Production promotions.
